description: Little Princess, who has become a king? Is the world patriarchal? The minister can execute the grand princess of a country at will? So, in order to survive, she can only please the king and the naughty brother? No, Babyqueen is not willing! Not only does she not want to please these men, she also wants to compete for the throne as a queen! And in the presence of thousands of ministers scolded her king father as shit! Strangely, after the scolding, everyone seems to be looking at me!
